description:
Test build, not a release. For stable builds use the main branch.

1.9.1-dev1: works with Patcheddit 2.4.0 and 2.5.0-dev.1. With 2.5.0, our Explain Reddit blocks, Post to profile, Fix history import, Fix broken markdown links and Fix comment video links step aside for Patcheddit's own versions.
Test with Patcheddit 2.5.0-dev.1: patching succeeds; one MY PROFILE button; u/name links; comment videos; image upload in a text post.
Test with Patcheddit 2.4.0: same as 1.9.0.
